name: Bridal Veil Falls
description: Discover one of Utah Valley's most recognizable natural landmarks. This beautiful 607-foot waterfall is accessible by a scenic trail along the Provo River Parkway, with nearby picnic areas.
alt: Bridal Veil Falls in Provo Canyon, Utah

name: Timpanogos Cave National Monument
address: 2038 W Alpine Loop Road, American Fork, UT 84003
description: Explore an underground world of spectacular limestone formations, winding passages, and beautiful cave chambers. Guided tours take visitors through three connected caves after a challenging hike up the mountainside.
alt: Timpanogos Cave Monument in American Fork, Utah

name: Thanksgiving Point
description: Experience one of Utah Valley's largest family destinations, featuring beautiful gardens, interactive museums, a butterfly biosphere, and educational attractions for visitors of all ages.

name: Sri Sri Radha Krishna Temple
description: Visit a unique temple inspired by traditional Indian architecture. Its colorful design, intricate details, landscaped grounds, and panoramic mountain views make it a distinctive destination in Utah Valley.
alt: Sri Sri Radha Krishna Temple in Spanish Fork, Utah

name: Utah Lake State Park
description: Enjoy Utah Valley's largest lake and its surrounding mountain scenery. Visitors can experience boating, fishing, camping, and other outdoor recreational activities.
alt: Utah Lake State Park in Provo, Utah

name: Springville Museum of Art
description: Explore Utah's first visual arts museum, featuring an impressive collection of local artwork alongside American and international pieces. Rotating exhibitions provide something new to discover throughout the year.
alt: Springville Museum of Art in Springville, Utah

name: Provo Pioneer Village
description: Step back into Utah's pioneer history through a collection of historic buildings and artifacts. This outdoor historical attraction offers a glimpse into the lives and experiences of early settlers.
alt: Provo Pioneer Village in Provo, UT

name: Roots of Knowledge
description: Discover an extraordinary stained-glass installation at Utah Valley University. Thousands of pieces of glass come together to illustrate humanity's journey through history, science, culture, and discovery.
alt: Roots of Knowledge at Utah Valley University
